home.title: Japanese beauty,
home.lead: The technique, service, hygiene, counselling and management a Japanese salon lives by. Standards built on the salon floor in Japan — now learnable from anywhere in the world.
home.categoriesLead: Choose by what you want to learn, not by instructor.
home.catSalonDesc: Cleanliness, conduct and space — the foundation.
home.catManagementDesc: Pricing, repeat visits and training staff.
home.catTechniqueDesc: Lashes, brows, makeup — designed to last.
home.catFemcareDesc: Advice that fits each stage of a woman's life.
home.featuredLead: The three most often chosen by newcomers.
home.whyLead: There are three reasons guests from overseas choose a Japanese salon.
home.why1Desc: Judged not on the day, but by how the work looks two weeks later.
home.why2Desc: Hygiene is defined by numbers and procedure, so it never depends on who is working.
home.why3Desc: Noticing what a guest needs before they have to say it.
home.flowLead: What you learn stays with you as a certificate of completion or certification.
home.flow1Desc: 6–12 minutes per lesson, with PDF materials and transcripts you can revisit any time.
home.flow2Desc: Pass the quiz and your completion is recorded.
home.flow3Desc: Receive a certificate — or a certification for qualifying courses — verifiable on the web.
home.finalNote: No expiry. Watch as many times as you like after purchase.
home.routesTitle: Not sure? Start in this order
home.routesLead: Choose what you want to learn and see the order to take it in.
home.routeSalonDesc: From cleanliness and service standards to systems that last.
home.routeTechniqueDesc: Japanese standards for retention and finish.
home.routeFemcareDesc: Advice that fits each stage of a guest’s life.

gettingStarted.title: Start here
gettingStarted.lead: From choosing a course to receiving your certificate.
gettingStarted.s1d: An education platform that turns the standards of a Japanese salon into something you can use on your own floor.
gettingStarted.s2d: Choose by what you want to learn. Not sure? Take the three-question quiz.
gettingStarted.s3d: No expiry. Watch as many times as you like after purchase.
gettingStarted.s4d: 6–12 minutes per lesson, with subtitles, so you can progress anywhere.
gettingStarted.s5d: Lecture PDFs, workbooks and checklists can be downloaded as often as you like.
gettingStarted.s6d: Confirm what you understood, organised into something you can use immediately.
gettingStarted.s7d: Your completion is recorded and a certificate is issued, verifiable online.
gettingStarted.s8d: Continue to advanced courses in the same field, or into a related one.
